No, express shipping isn't available for that plant. XL plants (usually over 4 ft, so your 5 ft bird of paradise qualifies) ship Standard only.

Here's what to expect for an XL plant:

- **Handling fee:** XL plants add a $20 handling fee.
- **Standard shipping cost:** $7.95, or free on orders of $75 or more (after discounts, before tax).
- **Standard delivery time:** 2-3 business days in Zone 1 (under 300 miles from the nearest greenhouse), 3-5 business days in Zone 2 (300-1,000 miles), or 5-8 business days in Zone 3 (over 1,000 miles, remote and island addresses).
- **Ship days:** Live plants ship Monday to Wednesday only. Orders placed after 12 noon on Wednesday ship the following Monday.

If you tell me roughly where you're located, I can help work out which zone applies to you. The excerpts I have don't say which zone a specific address falls into, so for an exact answer I can escalate to a Support Lead.
